I investigated the birth year of the 2023 Pritzker Prize winner. The 2023 laureate is British architect David Chipperfield. Multiple reliable sources, including the official Pritzker Prize website, Wikipedia, and Britannica, confirm that David Chipperfield was born on December 18, 1953. Therefore, the birth year is 1953.

Assignment: Birth year of the 2022 Pritzker Prize winner.

Result: 1965

Evidence: The 2022 Pritzker Prize was awarded to Diébédo Francis Kéré. Multiple sources confirm that he was born on April 10, 1965, in Gando, Burkina Faso.

The 2021 Pritzker Prize was awarded jointly to two architects: Anne Lacaton and Jean-Philippe Vassal. My research confirms that Anne Lacaton was born in 1955 and Jean-Philippe Vassal was born in 1954. Therefore, the birth years for the 2021 laureates are 1955 and 1954.
